What each outcome means
complete
valid report; every requested analyzer ran without a reported failure. Only these enter the primary analysis.
contract_only
valid report whose only problem is Cisco's known rule-registration error; used only in sensitivity analysis.
partial
a report exists but an analyzer failed or is missing; findings are preliminary evidence only.
failed
no usable report (timeout, scanner error, invalid JSON, hash mismatch, export error).
excluded_incomplete_folder
design exclusion: GitSkills lacks some supporting files, so the full-folder scan was not run.
missing
reanalysis only: the saved run has no report for this configuration.

Limitations and incomplete results

  • No security alert has been validated by a human yet. All 271 distinct alert locations are Cisco scanner output; none of them is a confirmed vulnerability.
  • 64 partial and 0 contract-only scan(s) are kept but excluded from the primary analysis (see the status definitions); their findings appear only as preliminary / sensitivity evidence.
  • 4 failed scan(s), 0 missing report(s) and 0 export error(s): these skills have incomplete coverage and are not "zero findings".
  • Most finding rows (884 of 1476) are metadata-quality notes (missing license, vague description, ...), not security alerts. "Skills with findings" therefore overstates security exposure; use skills with security alerts (55).
  • Snippets and other text from skills are redacted where they look like secrets, and absolute local paths are rewritten as repository-relative ones. Cisco's raw reports (local only, not committed) keep the original text.

Glossary

Scan
One Cisco run over one skill in one configuration (skill x configuration).
Configuration
Scope (SKILL.md only, or the full skill folder) x analyzer mode (static, behavioral, LLM, meta).
Primary analysis
Uses only COMPLETE scans. Anything else is reported separately, never as zero findings.
Alert row
One finding Cisco reported in one scan. The same alert seen in four configurations is four rows.
Distinct alert location
Rule + file + line within one skill, merged across configurations. The unit used for review.
finding_kind
Our classification: security (counted as alerts), metadata_quality (license, description, naming) or scan_coverage (binary files, analysis-incomplete notes).
Evidence check
exact: Cisco's evidence is on the reported line; ambiguous / mismatch: it is elsewhere or unclear; unavailable: nothing to check. A pointer for reviewers, not a correction.
Comparison change
additional: present only in the later configuration (e.g. full folder); removed: only in the earlier one; unchanged: in both. Pairs are 'eligible' only when both scans are COMPLETE.
Redacted
Text that looks like a secret is replaced with [REDACTED] before it reaches any report file.
